subject: Add helper function for padded pointer copy (#2388)
reason: The change only extracts already-identical inline code (memcpy of a pointer plus zero padding on 32-bit) into a new helper writePointerWithPadding(), used by encodeFailureReportKey() and encodeTimeoutKey(). The bytes written to the radix-tree keys are identical before and after on both 32-bit and 64-bit targets, the encodeTimeoutKey parameter reorder is applied at all call sites, decodeTimeoutKey is a pure rename, and the remaining hunks add a unit test for the helper. It is a behaviour-preserving refactor with no reachable observable difference, so no fuzzer scenario is needed.
